claim: On a plan's page, a link opens the closed row around its target and the target ends in view, a link to a row itself keeps the row's line in view though the row is taller than the screen, Back returns to the link and reopens a row closed since, a click on a row's line opens and closes it, and a row's line holds no link to Names while its chart does. Seen in Chrome and in the Mac's WebKit. Safari itself has not run it: its remote automation is off.
source: Google Chrome 156 headless, and WebKit 21624 in a WKWebView on macOS 26.5, where Safari 26.5.2 is installed
how: node observations/browsers/closed-row.probe.mjs on a Mac. It also runs Safari once Safari's Settings allow remote automation (Developer section), and says on stderr when they don't.
recheckWhen: page/page.js's links or Names walker change, or how page/render.mjs draws a flow's row changes.
